name: Ticket level propagation and entity-ticking versus block-ticking chunks
note: Load and simulation levels: 31 and lower entity ticking, 32 block ticking, 33 border. Scheduled ticks, block events and block entities run at simulation level 32 and lower, entities at 31 and lower; a level without players or forced chunks stops its entities and block entities after 300 ticks. Ticket changes take effect in each level's chunk stage, after its scheduled ticks
deviations: new chunks load at once; the official servers take 2 to 4 ticks, varying between runs
entity ticking per ring is observed but not compared, because item physics differ (V07, C3)
